snippet.title: Auto Astra Trailer
snippet.description:
Auto-Astra blends voxel-based construction with deep 4X automation. Design ships and stations, then write or use pre-made LUA scripts to automate your galactic empire. Strip asteroid belts, manage trade routes, and program tactical responses to enemy threats. Your logic, your empire. 

Wishlist now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2996550/AutoAstra/
